en.hubeali:
Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Muhammad Bin Ali, from Muhammad Bin Al Fuzayl, from Musa Bin Bakr, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> the 1<sup>st</sup>,

said, ‘I said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘Can the man borrow and perform Hajj when there was a replacement asset behind him what could pay it off on his behalf, when the event of death occurs with him?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Yes’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ahmad ibn abu ‘Abd Allah has narrated from Muhammad ibn Ali from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl from Musa ibn Bakr who has said the following:

“I once asked abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about one’s borrowing for expenses of al-Hajj, if behind him there is an asset that can pay off the loan, in case something happens to him. He (the Imam) said, ‘Yes, he can do so.’”
